482: /**
483:  * Tokenizer for [[JsonValue]] trees. Supports dotted path lookups that mirror
484:  * the Python `JsonTokenizer.tokenize_path`.
485:  */
486: class JsonTokenizer(val pretty: Boolean = false) {

488:   import JsonTokenizer._
489: 
490:   def tokenize(value: JsonValue): Token =
491:     Token(
492:       if (pretty) encodePretty(value) else encode(value),
493:       TokenType.Structured,
494:       immutable.Map("json" -> true)
495:     )
496: 
497:   /** Resolve a dotted path and tokenize the value at that path, if any. */
498:   def tokenizePath(value: JsonValue, path: String): Option[Token] = {
499:     val parts = path.split('.').toList
500:     if (parts.isEmpty || (parts.length == 1 && parts.head.isEmpty)) None
501:     else navigate(value, parts).map(tokenize)
502:   }
503: 
504:   private def navigate(value: JsonValue, parts: List[String]): Option[JsonValue] = parts match {
505:     case Nil => Some(value)
506:     case part :: rest =>
507:       value match {
508:         case JsonValue.Obj(entries) =>
509:           entries.get(part).flatMap(child => navigate(child, rest))
510:         case JsonValue.Arr(values) if part.forall(_.isDigit) =>
511:           val idx = part.toInt
512:           if (idx >= 0 && idx < values.size) navigate(values(idx), rest)
513:           else None
514:         case _ => None
515:       }
516:   }
517: }

525:     case JsonValue.Bool(false)         => "false"
526:     case JsonValue.Num(n)              => n.toString
527:     case JsonValue.Str(s)              => quote(s)
528:     case JsonValue.Arr(values)         => values.iterator.map(encode).mkString("[", ",", "]")
529:     case JsonValue.Obj(entries)        =>
